title: Screening automation with transformer models: a multi-review evaluation
items.abstract: <jats:p>Transformer-based classifiers were evaluated as title and abstract screeners across six completed reviews, with recall above 0.95 in five of them.</jats:p>

title: A crowd-plus-model pipeline for review screening
items.abstract: <jats:p>Non-expert crowd judgements were combined with a machine-learning ranker; the hybrid matched expert recall at a third of the cost.</jats:p>

title: Query expansion for biomedical search using large language models
items.abstract: <jats:p>A large language model proposed synonyms and related concepts for a seed query, improving reference-set recall by twelve points.</jats:p>

title: Automated risk-of-bias assessment: a validation study
items.abstract: <jats:p>A model answered RoB2 signalling questions from trial full texts with moderate agreement against human consensus.</jats:p>

title: A workshop report on reproducible search strategies
items.abstract: <jats:p>Notes from a methods workshop; no DOI was assigned by the publisher.</jats:p>
